text: Allah, who alone deserves divinity and worship, the Ever-Living who possesses all meanings of perfect life as befits His majesty, the Sustainer of everything, no drowsiness overtakes Him, that is, slumber, nor sleep; everything in the heavens and everything on earth belongs to Him, and no one dares to intercede with Him except by His permission; His knowledge encompasses all creatures, past, present, and future; He knows what lies before the creatures of future matters and what is behind them of past matters, and none of the creation can access anything of His knowledge except what Allah has taught him and revealed to him. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and the Kursi is the place of the Lord's feet—glory be to His majesty—and no one knows its nature except Allah, Glorified be He, and He is not burdened by preserving them, and He is the Most High in His essence and attributes above all His creation, the One who combines all attributes of greatness and pride. And this verse is the greatest verse in the Quran, and it is called: (Ayat al-Kursi).
